approach: vendor a self-contained gherkin-cli bundle beside the spec gate's check-suite engine so it runs from an installed plugin, which ships its tracked files and no node_modules

two additive spec-gate scenarios binding both directions from an installed plugin (well-formed passes, unparseable fails closed with its line) so neither a load failure nor a wave-through can satisfy them
a test that copies the plugin's tracked files outside the repo and runs the engine there, plus a staleness check that rebuilds the bundle and compares it byte for byte
scope held to check-suite; classify-edit-class, touch-set-correction and verify-scenarios import gherkin-cli the same way and are a follow-up

why: Additive: classify-edit-class reports 2 added / 0 modified / 0 removed on the frozen spec-gate.feature, so it self-clears and stays frozen. Cold sdd-spec-judge round 1 ALIGNED true (oracle/builder/architect all PASS); the builder lens confirmed no constant subject satisfies both scenarios and that 'with its line' separates a real parse failure from a module-not-found crash. Non-blocking observations: the sibling gherkin-cli engines still fail from an install (the classify-edit-class load failure degrades to unclassifiable, which escalates and does not wave through); the README paragraph names the mechanism. Pre-existing conformance warning (no What/Control Flow/Scenario map sections) is not from this CR. check-suite OK. Self-asserted within auto-all, low blast.

check-suite imports ../vendor/gherkin-cli.mjs (tsdown bundle of the pinned gherkin-cli with @cucumber/gherkin and @cucumber/messages inlined, no main guard, no require). Reproduced the bug first: the pre-fix engine copied outside the repo throws ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. check-suite-installed.test.mts copies the plugin's tracked files to a tmpdir with no node_modules on any ancestor, and asserts a well-formed suite exits 0 with 'suite checks OK' and an unparseable one exits 1 with 'cannot parse as Gherkin at line 5'. That binds both added scenarios in the discriminating direction #85 found missing. The bundle staleness test rebuilds and compares byte for byte. The npm bin path (#85) still passes check-specs-bin. Bundle placed in skills/spec-gate/vendor, not scripts/vendor, because aced's improve-skill validator crashes with EISDIR on a subdirectory under scripts/. pnpm verify green, cyber-sdd tests 1014 pass. Self-asserted with no cold impl-judge, because the two scenarios are bound directly by executable tests.
